第十章??虎计
水灵阁中，杨思纯突然捂住心口，额上鲤鱼印记灼痛如烙。全身布满汗水，瞬移珠的使用耗去了他一成半的法力。神识中的霓依已不见踪影，代之的是一个圆形符文。
“霓依”他踉跄站起，眼中血色弥漫。
几乎同时，大歪歪浑身焦黑地摔在阁前广场，口里喘着粗气：“济州岛...西...三角旋涡...霓依”
话未说完便昏死过去。
废焰老祖探查后吁了口气：“只是力竭，我们速去救霓依”
杨思纯探查一番大歪歪后丢下一瓶灵药便化作水光遁走。
三角旋涡海域，风暴已散，只余海面上未平息的漩涡。杨思纯悬停空中，闭目感知，终于在一处空间裂隙中找到了那颗血色丹丸。
丹丸入手温热，仿佛霓依生前的体温。表面血色蛇纹如心跳般明灭，内里隐约可见一条橙色小蛇盘踞沉睡。
“我定会复活你。”杨思纯将丹丸小心收起，声音嘶哑，“我发誓。”
望着坐在窗边发呆的杨，废焰老祖周身腾起暗红火焰，又强行压下：“胡嗖...老夫定要将他焚成灰烬！”
“现在不是冲动的时候。”江流云从阴影中走出，这些年他的隐流之术已臻化境，“霓依用生命换来的情报显示，胡嗖的老巢在济州岛火山下的‘风蚀洞窟’。但要救桐花我们需要计划。”
永珍握住杨思纯冰冷的手：“霓依的五个孩子呢？”
话音未落，五道橙色流光从窗口飞入，落地化作五位少年少女。他们约莫人类十四五岁的模样，额间皆有橙色蛇形印记，眉眼与霓裳有七分相似。
为首的长子躬身行礼：“恩公，母亲临行前将我们托付给您。她说...若她不归，让我们听您号令。”
杨思纯看着这五个霓依用生命守护长大的孩子，心如刀绞。他深吸一口气：“你们叫什么名字？”
“母亲为我们取名：霓影、霓光、霓波、霓涟、霓漪。”长子霓影答道，“这些年我们在汉江灵脉修行，得您灵石哺育，已具腾云驾雾、控水凝冰、化形分身之能。”
最小的霓漪眼中含泪：“我们要为母亲报仇！”
“仇要报，但不可莽撞。”杨思纯强迫自己冷静下来。

水灵阁，众人肃立，气氛凝重。杨思纯将血咒神丹封入圣坛最深处的寒玉匣中，设下层层禁制。
“霓依”他轻抚玉匣，思念如潮水般袭来。
奇袭风魔老巢方案阁中会议上，霓依五子坚持要参战：“我们有母亲的血脉，能感知风灵气的流动，可以找到桐花被囚禁的具体位置。”
江流云沉吟：“若如此...我可布下‘江隐大阵’，暂时屏蔽我们的气息。但此阵消耗极大，只能维持一个时辰。”
“一个时辰够了。”杨思纯目光坚定，“老祖，你我主攻。江流云布阵掩护。霓影五子，你们负责定位和干扰。永珍，你带其余人留守总部，加强防御。”
“我要跟你一起去。”永珍握住他的手，“清澜已经懂事，可以托付给秀雅。”
杨思纯看着妻子眼中的坚决，最终点头：“好。但我们得速战速决。”
---
三日后，子夜。
江隐大阵悄然展开，将杨思纯、永珍、废焰老祖和霓裳五子的气息完全遮蔽。他们如同隐形般潜入风蚀洞窟，直接绕过了外围防线。
霓影闭目感应：“母亲残留的气息...指向那里！”他指向上层一个洞穴。
众人悄无声息地摸去，果然在洞穴深处找到了被囚禁的桐花，永珍用水刃切断风链，废焰老祖立刻为大歪输送火灵气。
“胡嗖...在中央祭坛...”桐花虚弱地说，“他在炼制‘风魂幡’，需要九九八十一个修行者的魂魄...”
就在这时，警报骤响。胡嗖的声音在整个洞窟回荡：“既然来了，就别想走了！”
青色风暴瞬间充斥整个空间，江隐大阵在狂暴风压下开始崩解。
“按计划！”杨思纯厉喝，额上鲤鱼印记大亮，汉江之水通过地下灵脉被他强行引至此地，化作滔天巨浪冲向中央祭坛。

Chapter 10: Tiger Plan
In Shuiling Pavilion, Yang Sichun suddenly covered his heart, and the carp mark on his forehead burned like a brand. His whole body was covered in sweat, and the use of the teleportation beads consumed half of his mana. Ni Yi in the consciousness has disappeared, replaced by a circular rune.
"Niyi" He staggered to his feet, his eyes filled with blood.
Almost at the same time, Da Wai Wai Wai Wai fell to the square in front of the pavilion with his whole body charred and black, breathing heavily: "Jeju Island... West... Triangular vortex... Niyi"
Before he finished speaking, he passed out.
Ancestor Feiyan sighed after his investigation: "It's just that we are exhausted, let's go and rescue Niyi quickly."
After Yang Sichun explored Dawaiwai, he dropped a bottle of elixir and turned into water and escaped.
In the triangular whirlpool sea area, the storm has dissipated, leaving only the unquenched whirlpool on the sea surface. Yang Sichun hovered in the air, closed his eyes, and finally found the bloody pill in a space crack.
The pill feels warm in the hand, just like Niyi's body temperature when she was alive. The blood-colored snake patterns on the surface flicker like a heartbeat, and a small orange snake can be seen looming and sleeping inside.
"I will definitely resurrect you." Yang Sichun carefully put away the pills and said in a hoarse voice, "I swear."
Looking at Yang who was sitting by the window in a daze, dark red flames rose up all over the body of Ancestor Fei Yan, and he suppressed it forcefully: "Hu Sou...I will definitely burn him to ashes!"
"Now is not the time to be impulsive." Jiang Liuyun walked out of the shadows. Over the years, his hidden flow technique has reached the state of perfection. "The information Niyi exchanged for her life shows that Hu Sou's lair is in the 'Wind Erosion Cave' under the volcano on Jeju Island. But to save Tonghua, we need a plan."
Yongzhen held Yang Sichun's cold hand: "Where are Niyi's five children?"
Before he finished speaking, five orange streams of light flew in from the window and landed on the ground and turned into five boys and girls. They looked about fourteen or fifteen years old. They all had orange snake-shaped marks on their foreheads, and their eyebrows were somewhat similar to those in neon clothes.
The eldest son, who was the leader, bowed and saluted: "My benefactor, my mother entrusted us to you before she left. She said...if she does not return, let us listen to your orders."
Yang Sichun felt his heart twisting as he looked at the five children who Niyi had protected with his life. He took a deep breath: "What are your names?"
"Mother named us: Niying, Niguang, Nibo, Nilian, Niripple." The eldest son Niying replied, "Over the years, we have practiced in the Han River spiritual veins and been nurtured by your spiritual stones. We have the ability to soar in the clouds, control water and freeze ice, and transform into clones."
The youngest Niyi had tears in her eyes: "We want to avenge our mother!"
"You must avenge yourself, but you must not be reckless." Yang Sichun forced himself to calm down.
In Shuiling Pavilion, everyone stood in silence, and the atmosphere was solemn. Yang Sichun sealed the blood curse elixir into the cold jade box at the deepest part of the altar, and set up layers of restrictions.
"Niyi" he caressed the jade box, thoughts coming over him like a tide.
At the meeting in the pavilion on the plan to attack Feng Mo's lair, Niyi's five sons insisted on participating in the war: "We have the blood of our mother and can sense the flow of wind spirit energy and can find the specific location where Tonghua is imprisoned."
Jiang Liuyun pondered: "If so...I can set up the 'Jiang Yin Formation' to temporarily block our aura. However, this formation consumes a lot of energy and can only last for an hour."
"One hour is enough." Yang Sichun's eyes were firm, "Ancestor, you and I are the main attack. Jiang Liuyun sets up a formation to cover. Niying and the five sons, you are responsible for positioning and interference. Yongzhen, you lead the rest to stay at the headquarters and strengthen the defense."
"I want to go with you." Yongzhen held his hand, "Qinglan has become sensible and can be entrusted to Xiuya."
Yang Sichun looked at the determination in his wife's eyes and finally nodded: "Okay. But we have to decide quickly."
---
Three days later, midnight.
Jiang Yin's formation quietly unfolded, completely blocking the auras of Yang Sichun, Yongzhen, Ancestor Feiyan, and the five Nishang disciples. They sneaked into the wind-eroded cave as if they were invisible, bypassing the outer defense line.
Niying closed her eyes and sensed: "My mother's remaining breath...points there!" He pointedA cave on the upper level.
Everyone groped quietly, and sure enough they found the imprisoned Tonghua deep in the cave. Yongzhen cut off the wind chain with a water blade, and Ancestor Feiyan immediately sent fire energy to Dawai.
"Hu Sou...at the central altar..." Tonghua said weakly, "He is refining the 'Wind Soul Banner', which requires the souls of ninety-nine and eighty-one practitioners..."
Just then, the alarm suddenly sounded. Hu's voice echoed throughout the cave: "Now that you're here, don't even think about leaving!"
A green storm instantly filled the entire space, and Jiang Yin's formation began to disintegrate under the pressure of the violent wind.
"According to plan!" Yang Sichun shouted fiercely, with the carp mark on his forehead brightening up. The water of the Han River was forcibly led to this place by him through the underground spiritual veins, turning into a huge wave and rushing towards the central altar.
